metadata.note: MCP servers declared per agent and registered through each agent's own CLI (`claude mcp add -s user`, `codex mcp add`). For the QEMU VM harness (scripts/vmtest/qemu.sh install-driven, then drive with guest-mcp.sh). NOT for real hardware. Needs NETWORK in the guest: npm installs the two agent CLIs and uvx fetches the MCP server. The install itself CANNOT converge this domain — the agents' binaries are npm packages, not pacman ones — so the domain is deliberately left unowned by the install and the guest script drives the whole cycle afterwards, which is also the day-2 case the domain exists for. Autologins root on ttyS0 and ships python-pydantic/python-colorama so dasik runs from the 9p-mounted repo. `inkscape` is here so the MCP server can be exercised for real, not only registered.
metadata.disk: 8G is not enough with inkscape's dependency tree: run with DASIK_VM_DISK=16G.
